comment: GPIO Pinout Template - Copy and modify for your hardware

pinout._note_format: GPIO format is GPIO<chip>_<port><line> where port is A-D and line is 0-31

ANALOG_IN0._note: Channel 0-3 for single-ended, or 0-1 for differential

notes: Replace PIN_NAME with your application's logical names (e.g., PWM1, BTN0, RELAY0)
Replace GPIO format with the actual GPIO<chip>_<port><line> for each pin
Port encoding: A=0-7, B=8-15, C=16-23, D=24-31 (adds to the line number)
For I2C ADC: configure i2c_bus, i2c_addr (in hex), and channel (0-3)
See gpio_pinout_rpi4.json, gpio_pinout_rpi5.json, gpio_pinout_opi5_ultra.json for working examples
Set GPIO_CONFIG_PATH environment variable to point to your pinout JSON file
